channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Convenção do PL em SC tem pedido de voto de Flávio Bolsonaro; lei eleitoral prevê propaganda somente a partir de 16 de agosto
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro made explicit vote requests during the PL convention in Santa Catarina on August 1st, violating electoral law which prohibits campaign propaganda before August 16th. He also endorsed candidates including Jorginho Mello, Carlos Bolsonaro, and Carol De Toni. His speech was compared to Lula’s in Bahia, where the president made a more generic appeal for allied candidates before asking for his own vote.

item.title: Bia Kicis diz que Michelle Bolsonaro será candidata ao Senado: 'Acabou a dúvida'
item.description: Bia Kicis declared that Michelle Bolsonaro will be a Senate candidate for the Federal District, stating that 'the doubt is over'. Michelle had previously said she was still discussing the candidacy with Jair Bolsonaro and that her priority was caring for him, as he is under house arrest. The PL convention in the DF, scheduled for this Sunday (2), is expected to formalize the candidacies.

item.title: Missão lança candidaturas e 'desafia' Lula e Flávio para debate com Renan
item.description: The Missão movement officially launched Renan Santos as its presidential candidate and other candidates for state governorships, in a convention marked by boos for Lula (PT) and criticism of Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), with a focus on combating organized crime.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro chama Lula de 'projeto de ditador' e diz que vai 'demiti-lo' em outubro -
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), presidential candidate, called President Lula a 'dictatorship project' during a party convention in Santa Catarina and said he will 'fire him' in the October elections. The remarks were made at the event that formalized Jorginho Mello's reelection bid as governor.

item.title: Renan Santos ataca Lula e Flávio, chama Moro de 'vassalo' e promete 'matar quem roubar'
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate for the Mission party, harshly criticized President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro during his campaign launch, calling Sergio Moro a 'vassal' and threatening to 'kill whoever steals'. He rejected ideological labels attributed to him but maintained a hardline stance against corruption and violence.

item.title: Com ingressos open bar, Missão promove candidatura de Renan Santos à Presidência
item.description: The Missão party, founded by MBL creators, held its first national congress in São Paulo to promote Renan Santos’ 2026 presidential candidacy. The event, held in a nightclub-style venue with open bar, VIP sections, and jaguar-themed symbolism, drew a predominantly male crowd aged 30–40, featuring speeches by Kim Katagiri and Aroldo Medina, who referenced Jânio Quadros and emphasized male authority. Santos was praised by allies for his role in Dilma Rousseff’s 2016 impeachment, despite the party’s receipt of over R$3 million from the FEFC fund, which was not disclosed during the event.

item.title: Estreante em eleições, Renan Santos é empresário e fundador do MBL
item.description: Renan Santos, businessman and founder of the Free Brazil Movement (MBL), launched his presidential candidacy under the Missão party, created in 2025. He centers his campaign on public safety, advocating for harsher penalties, mass prison construction, abolishing presumption of innocence for gang members, and drawing inspiration from Nayib Bukele. His platform includes labor reform, a crypto reserve, drastic spending cuts, and tying mayors' re-election to performance targets.

item.title: PL lança candidatura de Bia Kicis ao Senado pelo DF
item.description: The Liberal Party (PL) launched the candidacy of federal deputy Bia Kicis for the Senate in the Federal District, following two terms in the Chamber of Deputies. Kicis stated she seeks the Senate to oversee other branches of government, including the power to question Supreme Court ministers. She also confirmed that former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro will be the PL's second nominee in the race for DF's two Senate seats.

item.title: Flávio repete Lula e também pede voto antes do prazo permitido
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), a 2026 presidential candidate, publicly asked for votes at a PL party convention in Santa Catarina on August 1st, before the August 16th legal campaign start date set by the TSE. He mirrored the same action taken earlier that day by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) at a PT event in Bahia. Neither campaign responded to Poder360’s request for comment by the time of publication.

item.title: Assista ao discurso de Flávio Bolsonaro na convenção do PL em SC
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, senator and PL presidential candidate, spoke at the party's convention in Santa Catarina, calling President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva a "dictatorship project" and vowing to defeat him in the October elections. He urged voters, even those who dislike him, to support him to prevent the continuation of what he described as "this gang's government." The full 25-minute and 23-second speech was made available for viewing.

item.title: “Não vou dar gás nem celular para ninguém”
item.description: The Mission Party launched the presidential candidacy of Renan Santos in São Paulo, proposing policies on employment, security, and poverty reduction while criticizing welfare programs and stating he does not intend to expand the distribution of benefits such as gas and cell phones.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro compara situação do pai ao período de repressão durante o AI-5, na ditadura
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro compared his father Jair Bolsonaro's legal situation — convicted of attempting a coup — to the repression period under AI-5 during Brazil's military dictatorship. The statement was made on April 1st during his presidential campaign, sparking controversy for equating a judicial conviction for undermining democracy with historical authoritarian measures.

item.title: Após questionamento de Moraes, Flávio usa novo vídeo com Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: The PL convention in Santa Catarina aired a new video featuring Jair Bolsonaro's speeches, despite prior questioning by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes regarding the use of his image. The event, attended by Flávio Bolsonaro as a presidential pre-candidate, also included criticisms of the Judiciary.

item.title: Sérgio Moro é xingado e vaiado em congresso do Partido Missão
item.description: Senator Sergio Moro (PL-PR), a candidate for governor of Paraná, was heckled and booed during the National Congress of the Partido Missão in São Paulo, where Renan Santos formally launched his 2026 presidential bid. Santos accused Moro of betraying the legacy of Operation Car Wash (Lava Jato) by submitting to forces that, he claimed, destroyed the operation, and criticized Moro’s tenure as Justice Minister under Bolsonaro. Moro had joined the PL in March after disagreements within the União-PP federation, seeking to realign with the Bolsonaro clan.

item.title: Flávio está sendo preparado para perder para o Lula, diz Renan Santos
item.description: Renan Santos, the presidential candidate of the Partido Missão, launched his campaign in São Paulo and claimed that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) is being prepared to lose the election to President Lula (PT). He rejected the label and criticized his opponent during the party's first National Congress.

item.title: Caiado diz que Lula e Flávio brincam de 'esconde-esconde' e preferem discutir sobre Trump que educação no Brasil
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado criticized Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro for avoiding presidential debates, accusing them of 'playing hide-and-seek' and prioritizing international polemics — such as commenting on Donald Trump's dentures — over national issues like education. He claimed his candidacy is more competitive due to his clean record, emphasizing 40 years in public office without involvement in scandals like mensalão, petrolão, or illicit enrichment.

item.title: Convenção do PSD lança Arruda candidato ao GDF sem vice definido
item.description: The PSD launched José Roberto Arruda as its candidate for Governor of the Federal District, despite his conviction for administrative improbity and ineligibility in six cases, currently under review at the STF. Arruda claims he will use the loosening of the Clean Record Law to defend his candidacy registration until August 15. The event featured support from Ronaldo Caiado, Gilberto Kassab, Alberto Fraga, and Izalci Lucas, but no vice-governor has been confirmed yet.

item.title: A palestra de Dias Toffoli na República Dominicana
item.description: Minister of the TSE and STF, Dias Toffoli, participated in a seminar in the Dominican Republic on artificial intelligence and electoral management in Latin America and the Caribbean. He spoke on a panel about the exchange between electoral bodies regarding advances and challenges of AI in the region. The event included representatives from international organizations and countries outside the region.

item.title: Lula e Flávio são “grandes adversários da população”, diz Caiado
item.description: Former Governor of Goiás Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) stated that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) are 'great adversaries of the Brazilian population'. The remark was made in Florianópolis during the PSD state convention that formalized the candidacy of former Chapecó mayor João Rodrigues for governor of Santa Catarina. Caiado positioned himself in opposition to both the federal government and the Bolsonaro family.

item.title: Em convenção, PCB confirma Edmilson Costa como candidato à Presidência
item.description: The Brazilian Communist Party (PCB) officially nominated Edmilson Costa as its presidential candidate for the 2026 elections, with Cleusa Santos as his running mate. Both hold doctorates and have backgrounds in academic political activism. Costa advocated for the nationalization of the financial system, suspension of public debt payments, and increased state control over exchange rates, foreign trade, and enterprises.

item.title: Prendemos Lula e o STF soltou, dizem Deltan e Moro
item.description: Deltan Dallagnol and Sergio Moro released a photo together wearing shirts claiming they imprisoned Lula and that the STF released him, tying the Lava Jato operation to their 2026 election campaign. Dallagnol, a Senate candidate for Novo-PR, and Moro, a gubernatorial candidate for PL in Paraná, emphasize their Lava Jato legacy despite past judicial and electoral controversies.

item.title: Tarcísio ama Bolsonaro, mas não o filho Flávio, avalia cientista político
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas said he 'loves Jair Bolsonaro', which was interpreted as a gesture to consolidate support among the former president's voters, without showing explicit loyalty to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. Political scientist Josué Medeiros from UFRJ evaluated that the statement functioned as a strategic message to the Bolsonarist base, not as a show of force toward the ex-president's son.

item.title: Governo Lula altera medidas para ampliar crédito e estimular renegociação de dívidas
item.description: The Lula government issued a provisional measure allowing up to R$ 2.75 billion in contributions to guarantor funds to expand credit and stimulate debt renegotiation. The measure also permits the combination of public and private resources in the Desenrola Adimplentes program, aiming to ease credit access and reduce household indebtedness. The initiative seeks to boost consumption and support economic recovery.

item.title: Caiado diz que Lula e Bolsonaro são adversários da população e fala em desordem institucional
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, PSD presidential candidate, stated that Lula and Bolsonaro are adversaries of the population and contribute to institutional disorder in Brazil. He positioned himself as an alternative to the two main political poles, criticizing polarization and advocating for a government project focused on order and development.

item.title: Lula pede voto para Jaques Wagner na Bahia após senador ser implicado no Caso Master
item.description: President Lula urged voters to support Jaques Wagner and Rui Costa at the PT convention in Bahia, emphasizing the need to renew the Senate and back Jerônimo Rodrigues' re-election, despite Wagner being under investigation in the Master Case. He also asked for support for his own campaign in São Paulo, although the request was made before the official start of electoral propaganda, potentially subject to challenge by electoral authorities.

item.title: Assista ao discurso de Carol de Toni na convenção do PL em SC
item.description: Federal deputy Carol De Toni (PL-SC) attended the PL convention in Santa Catarina on August 1, 2026, where she criticized what she called the persecution of right-wing candidates by the Supreme Federal Court and stated that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) would be elected president to appoint four justices to the Court. She also declared 'who is Carlos is Carol' in support of Senate candidate Carlos Bolsonaro (PL-SC), reinforcing the family and ideological alliance within the party. The event launched the PL's candidates for the state elections.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio vai acionar TSE após Lula pedir votos para Jaques e Rui
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign will file a complaint with the TSE after Lula explicitly asked for votes for himself, Jaques Wagner, and Rui Costa during the PT's Bahia convention, violating electoral law that only permits vote requests starting August 16. Lula made the requests multiple times, stating he needed '2 votes' for his allies and asking for any 'leftover' votes to go to him. The event occurred on August 1st, before the official campaign period began.

item.title: Roberta Luchsinger pede investigação de suposto vazamento de conversas com Lulinha
item.description: The defense of lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger requested the PGR and Federal Police to open an investigation into an alleged leak of her conversations with Lulinha, son of President Lula, accessed by Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign during Operation Sem Desconto. The request includes seizing electronic devices of PF and STF agents with case access, amid accusations of leaks between Minister André Mendonça's office and the PF leadership. Both the PF and Mendonça's office deny the leaks.

item.title: Flamengo é a maior torcida do Brasil, diz Datafolha
item.description: Flamengo is Brazil's largest fanbase, with 22% of respondents supporting the club, according to a July 2026 Datafolha poll. Corinthians ranks second at 14%, followed by Palmeiras (7%), São Paulo (6%) and Cruzeiro (4%). The survey interviewed 2,004 people across 139 cities, with a 2-point margin of error and 95% confidence level.

item.title: As projeções do TSE sobre ações eleitorais que confrontam os dois principais candidatos
item.description: The TSE projects a record number of electoral actions in 2026 involving Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, driven by AI use, fake profiles, and irregular propaganda, with over 140 filings in the first six months — a 300% increase compared to 2022. The Court aims to resolve simple cases individually and reserve the Plenary for complex issues like AI and manipulated polls, while mutual accusations of dirty campaigns via bots and fake jingles intensify.

item.title: Área VIP e open bar: por que o Congresso da Missão é diferente
item.description: The Mission party held its congress on August 1st to formally confirm Renan Santos as its candidate, with the decision made early due to security concerns after he received threats and requested Federal Police protection. The event featured a VIP area and open bar, setting it apart from traditional party congresses with its distinctive format.

item.title: Geddel chega ao lado de Lula em convenção do PT na Bahia
item.description: Former minister Geddel Vieira Lima (MDB), a PT ally in Bahia, attended the party's convention in Salvador alongside President Lula, appearing in photos and videos shared on social media. Although he left the Temer government in 2016 amid a corruption scandal, Geddel retains significant political influence in Bahia, making appointments in state administration and supporting Lula and Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues. His presence reflects the PT-MDB alliance in the region to strengthen the governing coalition ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: PL confirma Carlos Bolsonaro e Carol De Toni para o Senado em SC
item.description: The Liberal Party (PL) confirmed Carlos Bolsonaro and Carol De Toni as its Senate candidates for Santa Catarina at a convention held in Florianópolis on August 1st. The event also formalized Jorginho Mello as the party's gubernatorial re-election candidate and featured Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL-RJ presidential hopeful. The ticket is supported by six allied parties: Novo, Podemos, Republicans, the PSDB-Cidadania Federation, and the Christian Democracy (DC) party.

item.title: O que é o "Livro Amarelo", base do programa de governo do Partido Missão
item.description: The Mission Party launched the 'Yellow Book', a 500-page compilation of MBL studies and guidelines that will serve as the basis for its government program in the 2026 elections. The work, divided into 14 chapters covering topics such as fiscal adjustment, public security, health, education, rare earths, and foreign policy, was developed by over 200 volunteers over two years. The party also formalized the presidential candidacy of Renan Santos, with Aroldo Medina as vice president, anticipating the convention due to threats received.

item.title: Renan Santos é oficializado em ato com ingresso de até R$ 7 mil e livro de propostas ‘de luxo’
item.description: The Mission Party officially launched Renan Santos' presidential candidacy at an event in São Paulo's Komplexo Tempo, featuring ticket sales from R$94 to R$7,000 and a 'luxury' edition of the Yellow Book priced up to R$7,000. The event included the announcement of the party's Instituto Livro Amarelo and the slate of legislative and state candidates, as the party seeks to surpass the electoral threshold for public funding. Federal Deputy Kim Kataguiri unveiled the definitive version of the Yellow Book and presented the party's new foundation.

item.title: Medo de 'chapa derrotada' faz partidos evitarem Flávio, diz professor
item.description: The isolation of Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in seeking national alliances reflects parties' perception that his candidacy has high chances of defeat in the 2026 elections, according to political scientist Bruno Bolognesi (UFPR). This fear of a 'defeated ticket' is leading parties to avoid supporting him, undermining his national electoral viability.

item.title: PCB oficializa candidatura de Edmilson Costa à Presidência
item.description: The Brazilian Communist Party (PCB) officially nominated Edmilson Costa as its presidential candidate for the October elections, with professor Cleusa Santos as the vice-presidential running mate. The ticket was approved on Saturday, the 1st, marking the PCB's entry into the 2026 electoral race.

item.title: Lula pede voto na Bahia, o que é vedado pela lei eleitoral até 16 de agosto
item.description: President Lula requested votes in Bahia for himself and PT pre-candidates for the Senate, which is prohibited by electoral law until August 16. Such conduct may lead to sanctions, such as fines, for premature campaigning.

item.title: Riedel oficializa candidatura e pede empenho do PP por Tereza Cristina na disputa à Vice-Presidência
item.description: Governor Eduardo Riedel officially launched his re-election bid in Mato Grosso do Sul, urging the PP party to support Senator Tereza Cristina as the vice-presidential candidate on Flávio Bolsonaro’s ticket. The convention, attended by around 10,000 people, also confirmed Barbosinha as vice-governor candidate and Reinaldo Azambuja and Capitão Contar for Senate seats. Riedel praised Tereza Cristina’s political articulation skills as vital for Brazil’s future.

item.title: Ao vivo: PSDB lança candidatura de Ciro Gomes ao governo do CE
item.description: The PSDB officially launches Ciro Gomes' candidacy for governor of Ceará in a live event at the Marina Park Hotel in Fortaleza on Saturday, August 1, 2026, at 5:00 PM. The event features running mate Roberto Cláudio (União Brasil), along with Capitão Wagner (União Brasil) and Alcides Fernandes (PL). The candidacy had already been formalized by the PSDB-Cidadania federation in a convention held on July 20.

item.title: Partido Missão oficializa Renan Santos como candidato e lança livro com plano de governo
item.description: The Partido Missão officially nominated Renan Santos as its presidential candidate in an anticipated event due to threats from criminal factions, launching the 'Yellow Book' with its government plan. Vice-presidential candidate Aroldo Medina announced plans for an incursion into the Alemão favela in Rio de Janeiro, while federal deputy Kim Kataguiri emphasized weekly broadcasts to showcase progress in fighting organized crime and corruption. The party also presented gubernatorial candidates in nine Brazilian states.

item.title: Lula e Flavio têm medo de Renan, diz vice na chapa do Missão
item.description: The vice-presidential candidate of the Mission Party, Aroldo Medina, claimed that President Lula and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro are afraid to debate ideas with Renan Santos, the party’s presidential candidate, fearing they would be 'exposed' by his intellect and chivalry. Medina also pledged to personally lead a security incursion into Rio de Janeiro’s Morro do Alemão to combat criminal factions if elected, heralding a 'new era of order and progress' for Brazil.

item.title: “Nós prendemos o Lula. O STF soltou”
item.description: Senator Sergio Moro (PL-PR) and former federal deputy Deltan Dallagnol (Novo) formalized their 2026 election candidacies in an event highlighted by a symbolic photo showing both wearing Operation Car Wash (Lava Jato)-themed shirts. The image's caption, 'We arrested Lula. The STF released him,' directly references the imprisonment and subsequent release of former president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, reigniting political debate over the Lava Jato operation and its legacy.

item.title: O “prendeu, matou” de Kim Kataguiri
item.description: Federal deputy Kim Kataguiri of the Missão party stated that a potential government under Renan Santos would reclaim areas dominated by organized crime, challenging the candidate to act if elected president. He said the government would demonstrate results in public security through a 'arrested, killed' approach.

item.title: Lula ignora lei eleitoral e pede votos para Jaques Wagner
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva attended the PT's state convention in Bahia on November 1st and called for votes in favor of Senator Jaques Wagner's re-election bid, despite ongoing Federal Police investigations into Wagner's ties with Banco Master. The event also formalized the re-election candidacy of Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues (PT). Lula's action is seen as violating electoral law, which prohibits the use of public office to promote candidates.

item.title: Lula defende eleição de progressistas para a Câmara e critica atual composição do Senado
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) advocated for the election of progressive deputies to the Chamber of Deputies and criticized the current composition of the Federal Senate, stating it does not represent the people's interests. He made these remarks during a party convention speech.

item.title: Convenção tenta evitar voto ‘TarciLula’ ou ‘Lularcísio’ para ajudar Flávio em SP
item.description: At the Republicans' convention in São Paulo, Tarcísio de Freitas was renominated for re-election alongside Flávio Bolsonaro, who sought to gain party support for his 2026 presidential bid. Both emphasized opposition to the PT and sought to ease concerns that the governor would pursue an independent agenda, eyeing 2030. Flávio warned against 'TarciLula' or 'Lularcísio' voting, aiming to create an electoral 'vaccine', while Tarcísio highlighted his administration's achievements and praised a potential alliance with a future Bolsonaro-led federal government.

item.title: Em convenção do PT-BA, Lula pede votos para si e aliados. Lei proíbe
item.description: At the PT-BA convention, President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva explicitly asked for votes for himself and for the party's Senate candidates, Jaques Wagner and Rui Costa, during the event that confirmed Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues' re-election bid. His requests for votes before August 16 violate Brazilian electoral law, which prohibits explicit vote solicitation prior to that date. Lula made the requests multiple times, including a statement urging voters to support him if they had 'a little bit of vote left'.

item.title: Quem dá mais, Lula ou Flávio? ‘Neutralidade’ do Centrão custa caro
item.description: Senator Ciro Nogueira of the PP brokered a rapprochement between President Lula and the Centrão, leading to the bloc's neutrality in the Flávio Bolsonaro candidacy, including blocking Senator Tereza Cristina as a potential running mate. This move, rooted in a long history of political alliances and corruption scandals, has directly affected electoral strategies in key states like Minas Gerais and Piauí, weakening the Bolsonaro ticket and strengthening Lula's position.

item.title: Republicanos lança candidatura de Tarcísio ao governo de São Paulo
item.description: The Republican Party confirmed Tarcísio de Freitas's candidacy for re-election as governor of São Paulo, with Felício Ramuth as his running mate, in a coalition with MDB, PL, PSD and other parties. The convention also approved Senate and legislative candidacies, featuring Flávio Bolsonaro's presence and Tarcísio's speech emphasizing public service and his political trajectory since the Bolsonaro government.
